correctness.rationale: Dissipativity gives Im(lambda)||u||^2=-gamma|u0|^2/2; nonzero epsilon and distinct v_i forbid a dark eigenvector. The exact secular equation g^2P′(z)=epsilon(i gamma/2+epsilon z)P(z) and the simple interlacing P′ roots imply lambda_j=epsilon theta_j-i gamma epsilon^2/(2g^2S_j)+O(epsilon^3). The associated norm-one eigenvectors converge to mutually orthogonal dark vectors, while the two lossy bright modes have a uniform decaying spectral cluster even at coalescence; finite-dimensional contour calculus yields the all-density-matrix fixed-tau>0 survival mixture. Direct independent matrix exponential at k=3, v=(-1,0,1), g=1.2, gamma=1.7, epsilon=0.004, tau=0.75 gave 0.420097863129 versus predicted 0.419994897257, and S=(9,9). The check is corroborative, not infinite proof.
residual_risks: No uniformity when detunings coalesce, k or g/gamma vary; no limit claim at tau=0. Numerical matrix computation does not prove all epsilon or k.
